facts: A new exemplar-based framework is presented.
A new exemplar-based framework unifies image completion, texture synthesis, and image inpainting.
Image completion is posed in the form of a discrete global optimization problem.
Texture synthesis is posed in the form of a discrete global optimization problem.
Image inpainting is posed in the form of a discrete global optimization problem.
The discrete global optimization problem has a well defined objective function.
A novel optimization scheme called Priority-BP is proposed for solving the discrete global optimization problem.
Priority-BP carries two very important extensions over standard belief propagation.
Belief propagation is abbreviated as BP.
The two extensions are 'priority-based message scheduling' and 'dynamic label pruning'.
Priority-based message scheduling and dynamic label pruning work in cooperation to deal with the intolerable computational cost of BP.
The computational cost of BP is intolerable.
The intolerable computational cost of BP is caused by the huge number of existing labels.
Priority-based message scheduling and dynamic label pruning are generic.
Priority-based message scheduling and dynamic label pruning can be applied to any MRF energy function.
